steps: Be a registered voter in Perry County, OH with reliable transportation and no felony conviction.
Contact the Perry County Board of Elections ((740) 342-2134) or complete the poll worker application.
Report at 5:30am on Election Day; work until polls close at 7:30pm and closing duties complete.
